# Zillow

> > Zillow is the leading real estate marketplace offering property listings, home value estimates (Zestimate), rental search, mortgage information, and agent connections across the United States.

Zillow provides comprehensive real estate tools including the Zillow App for mobile home search, Zillow Premier Agent for real estate professionals, and integration with sister brands like Trulia, StreetEasy, and Hotpads. The platform serves homebuyers, sellers, renters, and real estate agents with data-driven insights and 3D Home tours.

## Key Topics

- Zestimate (home value estimates)
- Zillow App
- Zillow Premier Agent
- Property listings and search
- Rental search
- Mortgage information
- 3D Home tours
- Zillow Group (parent company)
- Trulia, StreetEasy, Hotpads (sister brands)
- Real estate advertising
- Agent directory and connections
- Home values and market data
- Buyer and seller tools

## Core Platform

- [Zillow: Real Estate, Apartments, Mortgages & Home Values](https://www.zillow.com/): Main homepage for searching properties, rentals, and Zestimate home values
- [Download the Zillow App](https://www.zillow.com/buy/app-download/): Mobile app download page for Zillow's real estate search application

## For Real Estate Professionals

- [Zillow Premier Agent](https://premieragent.zillow.com/): Agent platform for lead generation and buyer connections via Zillow
